item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas mkha' klong gsang ba'i mdos chen la sgrub skong gsang ba gting rdzogs
item.coloph: de la dang po dpon gsas ni/ ston pa gshen rab zhes bya ba/ mtshan dpe gzi brjid dang ldan pa des/ 'gro ba'i don du mdzad do// mdos bsngo sgo dbye lam bstan dang / khal 'gel 'phrang bsgyur shi sa bstan/ grub nas phywa tshe dbang skur rnams/ sham po gangs kyi ra ba nas/ sprul sku rma'is gter zhal phye/ rgya rgya rgya/ dam med la u ya// 13 'di'i gsang yig rnams zhang yig tu yod/
